title: Lumberjack Buyer
body:
Builder: MSET <mob vnum> SHOPKEEPER ON, then MSET <mob vnum> SHOPTYPE lumberjack.
Buys harvested wood: Kindling, Birch, and Oak/Ironwood/Heartwood/Yew logs. Pays 1.5 times the standard item sale price, compared with 0.5 at general stores. Use SELL <name>, SELL ALL <name>, BUY and LIST.

Quick builder setup: MSET <mob vnum> FLAGS ShopLumberjack. The Shopkeeper role is implied.
